scenes.summary: Endfield has prepared a Frontiers Survival Training for operators dispatched to new environments. You find Instructor Klara in Valley IV — time to start the training!

lines.text: Hey, Endmin!
I'm Klara! I'll be your instructor for this survival training!
The purpose of this training is to familiarize you with Valley IV, so you can handle anything that comes your way.
Alrighty, Endmin! Let's get started with the Valley IV Frontiers Survival Training!
Hehe... Lil' Dodge didn't trick me. There really are hidden perks to being a Frontiers training instructor.
I'll submit more applications when I get back. Hopefully I can be an instructor for a few more sessions ... and maybe even lead training in other environments.
Bet everyone in Alloycarrot would flip if they knew I'm actually running special training for the Endmin!
Oh, before I forget! Endmin, this special training's divided into multiple sessions that become available on a regular basis!
Alright, let's kick things off! Trust me, this is going to be super fun and packed with surprises!

options: I'm an Endfielder. I do Endfield stuff.
Yeah ... can't believe even I have to go through training.

r: I'm an Endfielder. I do Endfield stuff.
Yeah ... can't believe even I have to go through training.

lines.text: Endmin, this survival training will help you get up to speed with the area.
Please take it seriously, as mastering the skills will cut your field risk.

options: Let's go! Valley IV Frontiers Survival Training.

r: Let's go! Valley IV Frontiers Survival Training.

lines.text: You finished in no time! Awesome as always, Endmin!
You know, by tradition, I always give praise like this: you're the best operators I've ever trained.
Well, the Logistics Operators recently updated the terminal to show performance scores.
So everyone keeps refreshing their records. The top spot changes at least three times a day!
Ever since then, all my carefully written compliments went to waste...
Endmin, deep down, I really believe you are THE best!
Feel free to try the timed ultimate training and set a new record!

options: Then we'd better stick to tradition.
Oh, so I'm not THE best?
